scope: Seven fixed early audit games; source discovery only, no account session or playback observation.
methods: Exact date, matchup and game ID full-replay web searches.
Opened all seven canonical NBA game-summary, box-score and play-by-play URLs.
Searched NBA/team highlights and opened promising official video listings.
No account access, purchases, paywall bypass, full-game downloads, or browser shared state used.

common_sources.title: Full Game Replays and Condensed Game Availability
common_sources.observed_evidence: Article updated October 7, 2026. Requires active League Pass subscription; NBA.com route is Games, desired game, Watch Now below player, desired stream.

limitations: Page resolution and indexed replay labels are not evidence of playable full-game access.
Web tools cannot establish entitlement, regional availability, stream duration or complete coverage without actual authorized playback.
Some official pages extract only navigation/metadata; title resolution does not verify the event rows or video.
April 19, 2021 MEM/DEN highlights appeared in search but were excluded because the required game is April 26.
No independent annotation or audit eligibility established.
